summary: Iteration 144: Change Freeze Calendar + All-Clear Broadcast - All 29 backend tests passed (100%), Frontend fully functional with all CRUD operations working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Change Freeze Calendar fully tested. All backend CRUD APIs working. Frontend page loads with 3 stat tiles, New freeze button, active-only switch. Editor dialog has all fields (title, client picker, datetime inputs, 5 kind chips, reason, active switch). Create/Edit/Delete operations all working.

change_freeze_backend.POST /api/change-freezes: PASS - Creates freeze with id, title, client_id (null=MSP-wide), starts_at, ends_at, kinds[], reason, active. Returns 400 if dates missing.
change_freeze_backend.GET /api/change-freezes: PASS - Lists all freezes with hydrated client_name. Supports ?client_id=X and ?active_only=true filters.
change_freeze_backend.GET /api/change-freezes/active: PASS - Returns currently active windows (within time range and active=true).
change_freeze_backend.GET /api/change-freezes/check: PASS - Boolean is-frozen check. Returns {frozen, matches[], client_id, kind}. Supports ?client_id=X&kind=patch.
change_freeze_backend.GET /api/change-freezes/{id}: PASS - Fetches single freeze. Returns 404 on missing.
change_freeze_backend.PUT /api/change-freezes/{id}: PASS - Updates freeze. Returns 404 on missing.
change_freeze_backend.DELETE /api/change-freezes/{id}: PASS - Removes freeze. Returns 404 on missing.

all_clear_broadcast.POST /api/chat/broadcast/all-clear-check: PASS - Posts 'All clear' message when (a) storm message exists today, (b) mood is sunny/beach, (c) no storm_clear already posted. Idempotent.
all_clear_broadcast.POST /api/chat/broadcast/tick: PASS - Returns 4 keys: sentiment_posted, sla_posted, storm_posted, all_clear_posted
all_clear_broadcast.POST /api/chat/broadcast/storm-check: PASS - Posts storm warning when mood is stormy. Idempotent per day.

frontend_change_freeze_page.Create freeze: PASS - Saves freeze and adds to list with state badge (UPCOMING/ACTIVE NOW/ENDED), client name, date range, kind chips, reason
frontend_change_freeze_page.Edit freeze: PASS - Opens editor with existing data, saves updates
frontend_change_freeze_page.Delete freeze: PASS - Prompts confirm, removes from list

sidebar_navigation.Freeze Calendar link: PASS - Present under 'Change & Incidents' submenu in Service Desk section

recharts_warning_suppression.description: Console.warn filter added to suppress cosmetic Recharts warnings about chart dimensions (0 width/height, -1 values) during route transitions

notes.all_clear_logic: All-clear broadcast only fires when: (1) storm message exists today (ref_type=storm_mood), (2) current weather mode is sunny/beach, (3) no storm_clear ref already exists today. Since mood is currently 'stormy', all-clear returns posted:0 as expected.
notes.msp_wide_freeze: When client_id is null/empty, freeze applies to all clients (MSP-wide). Client-specific freezes only match that client.
notes.kind_filter: The /check endpoint respects the kinds array - if kind=patch is requested but freeze only blocks 'reboot', it won't match.
